bio: If you’re keen to explore the more personal side of chef Ricardo Temiño’s cooking, this offshoot of the La Fábrica restaurant, but with the same entrance, is a space with its own individual character where the aim is to explore the rich culinary culture of Burgos in more depth. The experience begins with appetisers in front of the reception area, where you’ll find the extensive wine cellar, before heading into the kitchen (accompanied by the chef) to see how they age lamb, before moving on to the modern dining room with its semi-open kitchen.
